about: Gate ET5's controls, sweep and fixtures as the seat account: replay run 45119522138 of flow/axil-timer, dispatched on main at c0ba283c (the merge of ip#464) with controls set and no model. In its replay job, with NIRMAAN_SEAT_TOOLS naming the seat account's wrappers, scripts/live_eval_controls.py ran the seven timer controls, the reference and all 99 mutants of evals/flow/axil_timer/mutant_sweep.json, and 402 gate fixture tests. Copied from the run's upload live-eval-controls-45119522138 (summary.json, controls.json, sweep.json and the two JUnit files), with the run's job ids. Controls: all seven gave the verdicts of evals/flow/controls_record.json. Sweep: all 100 rows gave the record's result, error count and first failure, on Icarus 12.0 where the record was written on 13.0. Fixtures: 390 passed and 12 failed, so the replay job failed at that step: 11 bypass controls, whose payload, with the screen bypassed, did not reach its target outside the run's view as the account, and one must-pass test, a formal setup over an approved file linked beside it, which did not run as the account. The reference answer's replay passed, its re-judge was the same, and the reach test denied every probe in the replay and rejudge jobs. Whether ET5 is met is verification-lead's statement, not this record's.
